head: Recipe Lab Studio develops camera RAW photos on your iPhone, one payment
dek: Recipe Lab Studio takes the RAW files from your camera and develops them on your phone, with no computer, account or subscription. It was #60 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It costs $22.99 once, with in-app purchases, by Imaginary Narrative.
means: If you shoot with a camera, you can edit RAW photos without a laptop or a monthly fee.
todo: Find Recipe Lab Studio in the App Store.
